chunks: And certainly, messengers were denied before you, so they bore patiently with what they were denied and were hurt, until Our help came to them. And there is no changer of the words of Allah, and certainly there has come to you from the news of the messengers.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the patience of prophets in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Sabr* (patient endurance) as a defining trait of the Prophets, linking their historical persecution to the eventual divine victory (*Nasr*). It serves as a reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the faithful that the immutable nature of God's promise (*Kalam Allah*) guarantees the triumph of truth over falsehood, a theme frequently echoed in the narrative of the Ahl al-Bayt's own trials.
